decisions.name: 黃智賢
decisions.reason: 2019-03-04 am730 source still of Ben Wong Chi-yin; Commons page explicitly identifies actor 黃智賢, structured depicts Ben Wong, linked Wikidata Q701907 and original YouTube video. YouTubeReviewBot checked original CC BY 3.0 on 2021-09-23, followed by manual Commons review by Yeeno. Visually inspected actual 600x720 JPEG plus eyes/nose/mouth/chin/full PNG: one clear 3/4-view face, both eyes and brows, full nose, full lips, chin visible progressively; no microphone, watermark, secondary face or obvious pixel defects. Hairline is tight but face remains recognizable. Existing live banks and aliases checked for duplicates; none found. Attribution to am730 and crop modification notice required.

notes: Exact SHA and crop approval only; no claim of production deployment until branch QA, main merge, Pages build and live QA pass.
Source CC BY 3.0 permits cropping with attribution and modification notice.
Do not auto-approve other source-only photos.
